capabilities.lan: not defined in reviewed v2.22; name/id/state only

capabilities.requires: normal account authorization; actual project access unverified

capabilities.local_implementation: one-shot inventory only; no persistent event receiver
capabilities.limits: snapshot receipt time is not device event time or proof of fresh state

capabilities.lan: documented product types include lighting, curtain, relay, HVAC, panel and sensor classes
capabilities.local_implementation: recognize type names; normalize a subset of light/curtain/motion/contact/climate state; report unmapped fields
capabilities.limits: type recognition does not grant control or prove all features supported by a specific product/firmware

capabilities.lan: pt=134 level 1..8 reports bands; level 4 is 150..250 lux
capabilities.local_implementation: preserve band and unknown exact lux
capabilities.limits: a band crossing a requested threshold cannot decide the threshold; new exact-lux properties need separate documentation

capabilities.lan: third-party LAN control must already be accessible
capabilities.local_implementation: no cloud sign-in fallback or live write path
capabilities.limits: gateway discovery, configuration and model confidence grant no control permission

configuration_contract.integration: home-connect stores profile.private.json per gateway outside Git
configuration_contract.identity: connection ID + node type + exact 64-bit integer ID
configuration_contract.unknown_values: null; do not substitute zero, false, empty rules or guessed settings
configuration_contract.privacy: private rows stay in runtime storage; console includes aggregate coverage only
configuration_contract.freshness: sequential snapshot, not atomic; state_fresh stays null

implemented_contract_tests: mixed inventory over a real loopback socket without writes
online versus light power; no motion versus occupancy
curtain position without an assumed opening direction
unmapped HVAC channels and unknown product types remain explicit
temperature unit conversion and 64-bit identity preservation
scene active/name is not a complete action definition
unknown scene extensions do not create executable actions
missing collections versus observed empty collections
invalid values, duplicate IDs and malformed rows
private file storage and aggregate-only console output
decision_quality_cases_to_build_after_co: lighting power, dimming, color temperature and per-home presets
room/group/scene scope and multi-target partial failures
motion, occupancy, ambient light and time conditions
light fade duration versus execution delay versus absence timeout
manual override and conflicts with existing automations
stale state, reconnect, missing events and offline device
curtain/HVAC channel semantics only after supported mappings are verified
held-out household/configuration groups and explicit owner preferences

next_steps: Obtain newer LAN documents or confirmation of configuration export coverage.
Read one authorized installed environment; keep real identity mappings and configuration outside Git.
Define supported actions from verified configuration, with unknown/unsupported/clarify alternatives.
Expand synthetic decision fixtures from capabilities and boundary conditions, then review real preference labels.
Keep new held-out household/configuration groups sealed before comparing rule, head-only and QLoRA baselines.
